# Go Play Sports Club & Academy, Kota

> Sports club and academy in IPIA, Kota, Rajasthan, India. Kota's first all-weather swimming pool and first pickleball courts, plus wooden badminton courts, a rooftop cricket & football turf, a gym and the Halftime Café. 50,000+ sq ft, 15+ sports and activities, 300+ active members, rated 5.0 on Google from 502 reviews.

## Key facts
- Address: H1-203 (C1), Rd. No. 5, Readymade Garment Zone, IPIA, Kota, Rajasthan 324005, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 92566 71777 · Email: goplay.sca@gmail.com · Instagram: @goplay_kota
- Hours: club 6 AM–12 AM daily; court bookings 5 AM–1 AM; pool and gym close 11 PM
- Booking: WhatsApp or phone; Go Play app on Android (Google Play) and iPhone (App Store); online booking opening soon

## Court and pool prices by the hour (GST included, same on weekends; from goplaykota.com/book)
- Pickleball court: ₹500 (5–11 AM), ₹350 (11 AM–3 PM), ₹600 (3 PM–1 AM)
- Badminton court: ₹500 (5–11 AM), ₹350 (11 AM–3 PM), ₹500 (3 PM–1 AM)
- Turf (box cricket / football): ₹1,200 (5–11 AM), ₹1,000 (11 AM–3 PM), ₹1,200 (evening)
- Swimming pool: ₹250 per swimmer per hour (6 AM–11 PM; closed 2nd & 4th Monday) · Jacuzzi: ₹500 per 30 min, ages 13+
- Up to 4 hours per booking; no membership needed; cancel up to 4 hours before for a full refund to the Go Play wallet

## Memberships (from goplaykota.com/plans, GST included)
- All-Pass (individual): ₹4,500 / 1 month, ₹12,000 / 3 months, ₹21,000 / 6 months, ₹25,000 / 1 year (≈ ₹2,083/month), ₹86,000 / 3 years
- All-Pass (couple): ₹7,500 / 1 month, ₹21,000 / 3 months, ₹35,000 / 6 months, ₹59,000 / 1 year, ₹1,56,000 / 3 years
- All-Pass (family, up to 4): ₹14,000 / 1 month, ₹36,000 / 3 months, ₹63,000 / 6 months, ₹99,000 / 1 year, ₹2,60,000 / 3 years
- Badminton from ₹1,200/month (yearly) · Pickleball from ₹6,000/month · Swimming from ₹1,500/month (yearly) · Gym from ₹1,125/month (yearly) · Gym + Swim from ₹1,750/month (yearly)

## Academy (coaching)
- Badminton: max 6 per batch, 3–8 PM, from ₹3,200/month
- Pickleball: max 6 per batch, from ₹2,500/month
- Cricket: 5–6 PM, from ₹2,200/month
- Swimming: add-on, from ₹1,000/month
